subject: Audit playbook: sample extraction window & boundary questions
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Bright Audit <audit@bright-audit.com>, security@acme.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Audit playbook: sample extraction window & boundary questions

Hi Lena / Acme team,

As we kick off the audit intake, we want to align on the "playbook" for evidence sampling and boundary artifacts so there are no surprises during collection. Quick context: Acme has asked us to support both ISO 27001 control attestations and a FedRAMP scoping exercise for the upcoming pre-audit in July.

Asks from Redwood:
- Confirm the preferred sample windows (logs/config snapshots) for network and auth controls. We can provide rolling extracts but want the exact date ranges to pull.
- Are you expecting raw syslog vs parsed CSVs? Any schema preferences?
- Which controls require encryption/KMS proof (key IDs, rotation logs)?
- Please confirm evidence intake link and any file naming requirements.

I'm attaching a draft control mapping and a simple system boundary diagram to help scope (attachments below). Can Marissa and Priyom please confirm owners for the controls listed in columns C–F?

Attachments: control-mapping.csv (stub), system-boundary.png (stub)

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min intake call; otherwise reply with the windows and format you prefer.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Lena Park <audit@bright-audit.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: 2026-05-03T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit playbook: sample extraction window & boundary questions

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from the audit intake side: 

1) Sample windows
- For log-based controls (auth, privileged access, network allow/deny): preferred initial window is a contiguous 7-day window. Proposed default: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07. If you need different dates, let us know.
- For configuration baselines and IaC: a snapshot as-of 2026-05-15 is ideal.

2) Formats
- Raw syslog is fine for network devices; for application logs a parsed CSV/JSON with timestamp + user_id + action is easiest for our tooling.
- For DB-level extracts, a schema description and column list are required; redacted exports are acceptable for PII as long as we get mapping.

3) KMS/Encryption evidence
- We need a signed rotation log and the KMS key ID(s). If you use a customer-managed HSM, please include proof of key custody and the rotation policy.

4) Intake and naming
- Please upload artifacts to the Drive folder you listed and prefix each file with ACME-AUDIT_{control-id}_{YYYYMMDD}.
- Alternatively, we can accept a secure SFTP; let us know.

A couple of follow-ups: do you have an existing test extraction pipeline (dry-run) we can validate for format? Also, can Marissa confirm whether there are any blackout windows for production pulls?

Happy to take a 30-min call next week — I'm available Tue/Thu morning PST.

Best,
Lena Park
Engagement Lead, Bright Audit

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <audit@bright-audit.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit playbook: sample extraction window & boundary questions

On Mon, May 3, 2026 at 8:14 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> As we kick off the audit intake, we want to align on the "playbook" for evidence sampling and boundary artifacts so there are no surprises during collection.

Thanks Lena — outlined below are our owners and commitments for the requested artifacts. Note the attachments referenced by Jonas are included in this thread (control-mapping.csv, system-boundary.png).

Owners and outputs:
- Auth & Privileged Access (control set A): Owner = Marissa Cole. Deliverable: auth logs (CSV with user_id, timestamp, outcome), sample window: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07.
- Network (control set B): Owner = Olga Petrov. Deliverable: firewall syslog (raw) + parsed CSV for allow/deny counts. Same sample window.
- KMS/Encryption (control set C): Owner = Priyom Das. Deliverable: KMS key metadata export, rotation audit log (YYYY-MM format), and KMS policy doc. We use AWS KMS CMKs (customer-managed); rotation is automated.

Blackout windows: we have a maintenance freeze 2026-06-03 00:00–06:00 UTC for a scheduled deploy; we'll exclude that 6-hour block from the log extraction and note it in the manifest.

Intake and naming: we'll upload to the Drive folder and follow the ACME-AUDIT_ prefix Lena requested. We'll also place a short manifest (manifest.txt) listing file hashes and any redactions.

Attachments (attached): control-mapping.csv (control id mapping + owners), system-boundary.png (diagram).

Action items:
- Marissa to provide a trimmed CSV sample by 2026-05-07 (schema only, no production data).
- Olga to validate firewall log retention and share extraction query by 2026-05-10.
- Priyom to export KMS metadata and rotation logs by 2026-05-12.

If that schedule works for Bright Audit, we'll lock the June window for the actual pulls.

Thanks,
Priyom
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
